root_cause.text: In stratix10_rsu_probe(), error paths for several commands call stratix10_svc_free_channel() (which sets chan->scl to NULL) but then fall through to queue further requests on the same channel, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the service kthread later accesses pdata->chan->scl in the receive callback.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "rsu_send_msg() can return -ETIMEDOUT when wait_for_completion_interruptible_timeout() fires while the SMC call is still pending. In stratix10_rsu_probe(), the error paths for COMMAND_RSU_DCMF_VERSION, COMMAND_RSU_DCMF_STATUS, COMMAND_RSU_MAX_RETRY and COMMAND_RSU_GET_SPT_TABLE call stratix10_svc_free_channel() - which sets chan->scl to NULL - but then fall through and queue the next request on the same channel. The next svc kthread that runs will dereference pdata->chan->scl in its receive callback path, triggering a NULL pointer dereference." The patch converts these error paths to goto labels that remove the async client, free the channel, and return early, preventing further use of the NULL scl.

candidates.rationale: Frees the channel (sets scl to NULL) but no return follows, allowing subsequent messages to be queued on the freed channel.
Second instance: frees channel without returning after DCMF status error, leading to further use of freed channel.
Third instance: frees channel without returning after max retry error, causing subsequent async message to use freed channel.
Queues a message on the channel after a previous error freed it, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the kthread processes the receive callback.
Queues another message on the already-freed channel, leading to NULL dereference in receive callback.

vuln_statements.explanation: Frees the channel by setting scl to NULL, but the code does not return, allowing subsequent send operations on the freed channel. This leads to a NULL pointer dereference when the service kthread accesses pdata->chan->scl.
Second instance of freeing the channel without returning after a DCMF status error. The freed channel is then used for subsequent messages, causing a NULL pointer dereference.
Third instance of freeing the channel without returning after a max retry error. The code falls through to queue an async message on the same freed channel, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.

Queues a message on the channel after a previous error freed it (the channel's scl is NULL). When the service kthread processes the receive callback, it dereferences pdata->chan->scl, causing a NULL pointer dereference.
Queues a message on the already-freed channel after a max retry error. The subsequent kthread access to pdata->chan->scl results in a NULL pointer dereference.

Queues an async message on a channel that may have been freed by a previous error. When the service kthread later processes the callback, it accesses pdata->chan->scl, causing a NULL pointer dereference.
